visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a white patterned blouse with a collar, stands in an indoor hallway. She smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. Behind her, a staircase and a white wall are visible under soft indoor lighting. (2) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands snapping a dark chocolate bar into two pieces against a solid red background. The texture of the chocolate is matte and smooth. Yellow variety-show style text appears at the bottom of the frame. (3) The camera pans over a pile of Snickers chocolate bars in their blue, white, and red packaging. A hand reaches in and picks one up, highlighting the retail context. The lighting is bright and industrial, likely from a supermarket. (4) A close-up shot of a long, brown, glossy chocolate-covered stick being dipped or coated. The surface is textured and reflects the bright studio lighting. Text overlays continue to provide information in Chinese characters. (5) The female speaker returns to the screen in the same indoor setting. She uses a finger-pinching gesture to emphasize the smaller size of chocolate bars. Her facial expressions move from curious to informative as she looks at the camera. (6) A graphic chart titled 'Cocoa Prices Are Hitting Record Highs' is displayed. The line graph shows a sharp upward trend on the right side. The background is white with orange and brown accents, appearing as a clean digital screen capture. (7) An aerial drone shot captures a long, dusty red dirt road stretching through a rural village with small, low-rise buildings. A single white car drives along the road, kicking up dust. The landscape is flat and sparsely vegetated under bright natural daylight. (8) The female speaker is shown again, looking contemplative. She touches her chin and uses her hands to narrate the struggles of cocoa farmers. The background remains the same neutral indoor hallway with soft lighting. (9) A close-up shows hands breaking off a square from a stack of milk chocolate bars. The pieces are stacked neatly. The focus is sharp on the chocolate's edges, emphasizing its physical properties and glossy texture. (10) The speaker concludes by presenting two solutions, holding up one and then two fingers. Her tone appears encouraging and inquisitive. The video ends with her looking directly at the viewer, inviting engagement about future chocolate consumption.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 哈囉大家. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近巧克力變難吃啊?. (3) [Subtitle]: 我最近去買巧克力都發現巧克力棒變小條. (4) [Subtitle]: 巧克力的部分變少了. (5) [Subtitle]: 整個味道變難吃. (6) [Subtitle]: 這是因為巧克力價格大飆升. (7) [Subtitle]: 由於氣候變遷. (8) [Subtitle]: 光是2024年巧克力的價格就上升了300%. (9) [Subtitle]: 其中重要產區迦納現在還有很多人跑去挖非法金礦不種巧克力了. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為可可農的收入其實非常的少是世界上最窮的農夫. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以現在全球巧克力都短缺估計呢一年少瞭50萬噸. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以以後巧克力可能真的要變成奢侈品了嗎?. (13) [Subtitle]: 這個時候我們有兩個解法. (14) [Subtitle]: 一個是推廣公平交易巧克力讓可可農可以獲得更高的利潤. (15) [Subtitle]: 第二個是人工製造的可可. (16) [Subtitle]: 用蠶豆發酵之後居然會有巧克力的香味你們想試試看嗎?.
